mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_discount (customer_id, name, discount_rate, apply_stage, skip_when_fixed_price, category_filter, product_keyword_filter, effective_from, effective_to, priority, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{name}, #{discountRate}, #{applyStage}, #{skipWhenFixedPrice}, #{categoryFilter}, #{productKeywordFilter}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{priority}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_discount WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_discount SET name = #{name}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, apply_stage = #{applyStage}, skip_when_fixed_price = #{skipWhenFixedPrice}, priority = #{priority}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
